video_title: Micah Nori Media Availability | Oct. 18, 2026 | Portland Trail Blazers

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive challenges without Drew Eubanks and Robert Williams III
quotes.excerpt: Without two of our better defenders, meaning Drew and Rob, we really missed them.
quotes.quote: Without two of our better defenders, meaning Drew and Rob, we really missed them, which is no excuse. Just felt that defensively, we didn't get a whole lot accomplished. Golden State is a little bit different than the rest of the league as far as the league is so pick-and-roll dominant. I know it's trying to trend away from that, but they've set that mark and just a lot of off-ball screens and a lot of movement in itself, and we didn't do very well against it.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says the Blazers struggled defensively against Golden State without Drew Eubanks and Robert Williams III, noting that the team did not get a whole lot accomplished against the Warriors off-ball movement.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson's injury status and recovery timeline
quotes.excerpt: We have four days for it to heal, and so we figured, why risk it?
quotes.quote: It was more so just an X-ray and knock on wood, nothing was broke. And we have four days for it to heal, and so we figured, why risk it? Just there is a little bit of swelling and even from dribbling to just normal contact, it's good to give him a little bit of a rest when you have those chances to do so.
quotes.social_post: Scoot Henderson is dealing with swelling but X-rays were negative. Micah Nori says the team is playing it safe with the four-day break, stating it is good to give him a little bit of a rest when you have those chances to do so.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's role as a facilitator and secondary scorer
quotes.excerpt: It gives you a facilitator and Ja for sure that's looking to push pace.
quotes.quote: It gives you a facilitator and Ja for sure that's looking to push pace. And then you also he can use him as a secondary scorer. You've got obviously the shooting ability and the scoring ability of Dame. And then it also allows Danny to get as many touches as he needs to and be efficient because Ja is just looking to distribute and facilitate.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori discusses the backcourt dynamic, noting that Ja Morant is serving as a facilitator to allow Dame to get his touches while acting as a secondary scorer to keep the offense efficient.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Scoot Henderson's impact off the bench
quotes.excerpt: When Scoot comes in off of the bench, I think he also is a facilitator.
quotes.quote: When Scoot comes in off of the bench, I think he also is a facilitator, but you get a little bit more of that downhill scoring ability and looking to score and putting pressure. And then I also feel with Toumani and with Donovan, you got top two, three wing and big defenders in the league starting with that group. So I feel good there.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori highlights the bench impact of Scoot Henderson, noting he brings downhill scoring and pressure, while praising Toumani and Donovan as top-tier wing and big defenders.

quotes.speaker: Micah Nori
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's growth and comfort with teammates
quotes.excerpt: It's just him getting comfortable with his teammates number one.
quotes.quote: It's just him getting comfortable with his teammates number one. I think he's fine with the system that we're playing, but also just getting used to playing NBA basketball at a high level again. And I think he's going to continue, things are going to slow down for him and get back to normal. I don't think it's going to take very long, but I think just the more he gets to play like all these guys, but especially him and Dame that have been out for so long, the more they get to play and see live action, the better things are going to start to click. And they just know that where their shots are going to come, what they can do, and even but for Ja more specifically, it's with his teammates, knowing where they are, knowing like when the difference, I know Rob didn't play, but when Brandon Carlson rolls and Donovan rolls and Toumani, what they all like to do in pick and roll and how they all want to play. So I think that familiarity has really helped him.
quotes.social_post: Micah Nori says Ja Morant is still getting comfortable with teammates and the speed of the NBA game, but expects things to click as he and Dame get more live action reps.
